node.title: HGE4 cyclotomic-Haar near-quarter swap router
node.statement: For an exact dyadic ratio level m and h=m/4-d, put X=4(d+1)log m and let B be the least power of two at least X. The inequalities B<h and BX<m^(1-(4d+8B)/m) force every primitive top shift pair to be antipodal-swap; 64(d+1)^2(log m)^2<m is a sufficient closed-form sub-band. Hence even widths in the exact band are empty and odd widths route exactly to the existing half-order perfect-square support problem. The theorem removes the free class in the band but does not count odd swap supports or close the lower-quarter aggregate.
